description.value: Trollers is a floating seafood restaurant moored in Nanaimo's working harbour, offering fresh halibut, wild salmon, and cod alongside smoked meats and bowls, all on a 100% gluten-free menu. Part of the Off the Hook Surf Turf and Smokery Family, the spot has both an open waterfront deck with ocean views and a covered indoor seating area for rainy west coast days. Its waterfront location on the Harbourfront Walkway puts it squarely on the route for cyclists exploring Nanaimo's coastline.

raw_osm.name: Trollers Fresh Fish and Chips

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is a waterfront floating restaurant in Nanaimo's harbor at 10 Wharf Street, matching OSM address and phone (+1 250-741-1609). The menu page explicitly states the menu is '100% gluten free' and lists a Sunshine Vegan Bowl, confirming GF/vegan options; the front page confirms takeout and online ordering. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM lists daily (Mo-Su) hours but the website contact page shows Thu-Sun only — operating days may have changed and should be verified before publishing.
Website copyright and seasonal-reopening language reference 2023; content may be outdated and current hours or menu details could differ.
Email address (trollersfishandchips@gmail.com) appears on the website contact page but is absent from the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate waterfront seafood restaurant on Nanaimo's Harbourfront Walkway with takeout, a fully gluten-free menu, and vegan options — a strong stop for touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo.
enrichment_extras.notes: The about page highlights proximity to Pioneer Waterfront Plaza, the Harbourfront Walkway, and Maffeo Sutton Park — all useful wayfinding context for cyclists. A site visit or phone call to confirm current operating days is recommended before publishing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page states 'our food menu is 100% gluten free'; menu includes a Sunshine Vegan Bowl (gochujang BBQ crispy cauliflower) explicitly listed as vegan
